label: Exactly one actual bearer at the…, from At least one individual actually exists at… and 5 more
description: Compose pointwise actual ultimate-source existence with the direct at-most-one result to identify every local source with the SAME actual witness, then prove uniqueness of the universal ultimate-source predicate.
